scope: YouTube plays in your own Chrome, with no stops.

topics.title: Help when YouTube stops
details: If your own Chrome does not have the Voice Companion extension, Companion now tells you.
Say set up Chrome to add it. Then videos play in your own Chrome.

topics.title: YouTube in your own Chrome
details: YouTube now opens in your own Chrome, even when Chrome is closed.
Before, it played in Voice Companion's Chrome. There you were signed out, so ads played.
Videos also stopped after a minute or so. YouTube said something went wrong.
In your own Chrome you are signed in. If you have YouTube Premium, ads do not play.
